terms: Pilot Edition: Pinoy Pages 2026–2027 (Category: Money & Business, Greater Toronto Area). The printed proof copy is released spring (April 16, 2027); the website is updated year-round.
Prices are per issue: Free; Verified $99; Verified Plus $199; Verified Ad half page $350 or full page $600 (an Ad includes Verified Plus). No add-ons, bundles or founding discounts in the pilot.

Verified Kabayan badge: payment never buys the badge. Paid tiers are only eligible; the badge is earned by a ~15-minute verification visit with three checks (kabayan-owned or run, really trading, ZCard completed). We may withhold or remove the badge if a check fails; the paid listing continues without it.
Free listings are unverified: name and contact only, with no badge, no QR code, no Save contact button and no ZCard.
QR codes always resolve through pinoypages.ca. Our pages never ask for a login, a payment or personal information.
Pilot price lock: advertisers who renew on time (paid by December 18 each year) keep their pilot tier price for the next edition.

Member renewal discount: existing paid members who renew by the on-time date (December 18) get a flat 20% off their locked price for the next edition (e.g. Verified Plus $199 becomes $159). Existing members only; not available to new sign-ups; does not stack or compound; valid for one renewal year and reviewed each edition.
Late renewal: renewals after the on-time date are charged the current regular price and lose the price lock and member discount.
Website mirror: your online presence mirrors your print presence and is included free in every tier.
No guarantee of results: we report scan counts monthly (Verified and up). We do not promise any number of leads, calls, sales or visitors.

Printed edition: a short-run proof copy for advertisers (one copy per paid advertiser) and a sales brochure for prospects. It is not sold or handed out to the public. If it does not print, print ad fees are refunded.
Prices are in CAD, plus applicable HST. Draft terms, to be reviewed by a lawyer before launch.
